newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list options on First Brands, three others.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list options on First Brands, three others.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said on Tuesday it would list options on four stocks on September 26.
The new options include First Brands Corp, Incyte Pharmaceuticals Inc, Movie Gallery Inc and Norrell Corp.
First Brands will have initial expirations of October, November, February and May, with opening strikes of 22-1/2, 25 and 30, the exchange said.
It said Incyte and Norrell options will have initial expirations of October, November, March and June.
Incyte will have initial strikes of 40, 45 and 50 and Norrell will have initial strikes of 25, 30 and 35.
For Movie Gallery, initial expirations will be October, November, January and April. Opening strikes will be 12-1/2, 15 and 17-1/2.
The PHLX said TFM Investment Group will be the specialist for all four new options.
